answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 38646 Country: India Title: I am a 26 year old Muslim girl. This year I have performed hajj, 5 days after hajj I saw in dream the holy Prophet Muhammad (SAW) while taking a brief nap after Zuhr Question: I am a 26 year old Muslim girl. This year I have performed hajj, 5 days after hajj I saw in dream the holy Prophet Muhammad (SAW) while taking a brief nap after Zuhr, he was giving sermon in green clothes (the colour of the dome over rauza mubarak), someone said come in queue to wash the feet of Nabi (SAW) then I poured water over his feet, I kept looking at him but he did not look at me and angrily said its enough. Then someone said come in queue to drink water from the holy hands of Nabi (SAW), I came running down some wooden stairs and got into the queue, I ran so fast that my slippers got off my feet, my mother was standing in the vicinity, I called her to come in queue, but did not find her in queue. There was so much heat of the sun over us (people in queue) people said oh Nabi (SAW)! Pray to Allah that He covers us under shade, he prayed then we all came under shade. A child was playing beside the queue in scorch heat, I wondered why shade did not cover him too and then I woke up for Asr salah. Answer ID: 38646 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 924/758/B=1433) If you are involved in bida'h and nonsense then you should give it up and pass your life according the Sunnah, then in-shaAllah, the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) shall drink you from the Hauz-e-Kauthar with his holy hands. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
